about_the_game:
O.A.C: World Begins – Official Soundtrack Album

This album captures the evolving atmosphere of a world edging closer to a Third World War, and reflects the futuristic narrative layers of O.A.C: World Begins.

Each track was crafted with months of meticulous work and grounded in mathematical composition principles.

How was it made?
The entire album was composed digitally. Dominant melodic structures are based on D♯ Major, D♯ Minor, and C♯ Major. Emotional transitions are deliberately designed to reflect a sense of victory amidst tension, fear, and unrest — mirroring the game's hauntingly triumphant tone.

These are all the instruments I used in the album:

  • Pianos/Keyboards: Grand piano, Electric piano, Ragtime piano, Church organ, Harpsichord

  • Guitars: Electro, Lead, Acoustic, Bass | Pedals/Technique: Distortion, Slap Bass, Muted, Clean

  • Drums/Percussion: Electric drum, Acoustic drum, Steel drum, Xylophone, Vibraphone

  • Strings: Violin, Cello, Concert harp, Pizzicato

  • Wind Instruments: Trombone, Flute, Saxophone, French horn

  • Electronic: 8-bit, Sci-fi, Synth pluck, Smooth synth

  • Traditional: Sitar, Koto

  • Music Box: Synth bass
